correctness.rationale: For any time-shift row, Φ5 irreducibility over Q(ζ6) makes a nonzero-modulation zero equivalent to all five sixth-root coefficients identical, giving four zeros; otherwise zero modulation requires an exact Eisenstein zero sum, giving one or zero zeros. Exactly six 5-root exponent multisets sum to zero (triangle plus antipodal pair). Matching windows and autocorrelation argument identify support 5 and 19 extremes and 20 case. Complete checkers verify all 6^8 normalized ordered pairs by distinct exact integer bases, and a separately implemented third vectorized enumeration reproduced the 8 support totals and complete row-zero profiles, with sum 1,679,616. The exhaustive domain is finite, and no sampling/float-zero or infinite extrapolation is invoked.
residual_risks: Only p=5, full-length sixth-root signals, normalized separately at the zeroth coordinate, exact algebraic vanishing.
No extension to arbitrary phases/other p, and no classification into all symmetry orbits.
